text:
lucas-partner: Heads up 1: ingestion alert from Jupiter partner: `usage_amount` field varies between numeric tokens and strings with currency-like prefixes (e.g., "credits:120", "120"). Validator rejects the prefixed form. sample: {"device":"d-42","sku":"edge-core","usage_amount":"credits:120"}

emi-eng: Thanks. Do we have a percentage?

lucas-partner: ~0.9% of hourly lines yesterday. partner says they switched to a unified agent that reports both credits and units in one field for backward compatibility.

diego-billing: When prefixed values are dropped, partner ledgers underreport and we issued small balancing credits. We should avoid silent drops.

anya-integrations: Quick mitigation: accept prefixed strings into quarantine and normalise them into two fields: `usage_value` (numeric) and `usage_kind` (credits|units). Mark provisional ledger rows non-invoiceable. Long-term: publish schema version 2 requiring structured fields.

ops-lead: Marketing impact? This affects a small pilot in LATAM. Partner asks not to delay joint GA announcement unless the rate exceeds 2%.

emi-eng: Proposed rules: parse prefix if present (regex ^([a-zA-Z]+):([0-9]+)$). If parsed -> create provisional rows with usage_kind set and route to billing. If parse fails -> quarantine. Alert if >0.5% prefixed_rate.

diego-billing: Agreed. Billing will hold invoiceable flag until partner confirms mapping for `credits` vs `units`. Drafting customer note: adjustments processed within 72h of mapping upload.

lucas-partner: Partner to send mapping doc showing how to convert credits->units for pilots (ETA 18h). They will also roll agent patch to emit separate fields (ETA 36h).

marketplace-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-1582 -> usage-field-unified-prefix (severity: low). Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-1582

anya-integrations: Action items:
- anya: implement prefix parser + quarantine + metric (ETA 4h)
- emi: backfill job + manual confirm endpoint (ETA 24h)
- diego: prepare provisional ledger workflow + customer note (ETA 12h)
- lucas: collect partner mapping CSV (ETA 18h)

emi-eng: PR merged to staging; alert rule added for prefixed rate >0.5%. Backfill scheduled after mapping arrives.

lucas-partner: mapping uploaded at 2026-04-12T02:40Z. starting reconcile.

emi-eng: backfill finished; provisional ledgers reconciled; held credits reversed where appropriate.

diego-billing: invoices updated; customers notified per SLA.

ops-lead: good closure. proceed with LATAM announcement as planned. :tada:
